headline: Higher use raised the bill; another plan costs less for this usage
explanation: The bill was {{bill_total}}, up {{bill_change}} from {{previous_bill}}. Usage was {{march_kwh}}, and daily use rose {{daily_change}}; the billing periods were {{feb_days}} and {{march_days}} days. Usage was above the peer average of {{peer_kwh}} by {{peer_difference}} across {{peer_count}} homes. The weather model associates use with heating, but it extrapolates beyond its training range; its {{weather_residual}} residual means weather is not a confirmed cause.
actions: Compare overnight schedules and equipment runtimes; the cause of the higher use is unconfirmed.
Consider {{best_plan}}; its estimate applies to the same March usage, not future behavior.
